main_methods.method: 先锁识读骨架，再对字群做负空间光学校正
main_methods.source: S1 instructional text; independent M/T pixel interpretation
main_methods.concrete_use: On the single Root-approved copy/lettering source, first preserve each character's necessary structural strokes. Correct pair gaps and dense interior gaps at the intended visible size. Change only local stroke endpoints/gaps needed for reading; do not solve every pair by individual scaling or dragging a long stroke to a cup or leaf. Keep frozen 茶作 wordmark outlines and photo source.
main_methods.M_evidence: The three large brand characters read as one compact, materially coherent group despite local irregularities and cut-outs.
main_methods.not_proved: S1 exercise glyph geometry was not seen, and no resulting 茶作 iteration was produced or reviewed.

main_methods.method: 先确定文字角色，再用可见字高和笔画重量建立层级
main_methods.source: Primarily actual M pixels; S3 platform draft is limited supporting context, not verified video teaching
main_methods.concrete_use: Keep 茶作 as the existing brand role. Treat Root's chosen short copy as a subordinate group with a shared alignment and quiet gap. Use approximately one-third to two-fifths of the brand's visible letter height as an initial support-copy trial, then inspect the actual full poster and a thumbnail. This is a starting visual relationship, not a new validator. Avoid repeating V28's enormous initial phrase plus smaller later phrase if it makes the slogan the first brand identifier.
main_methods.M_evidence: M has a large off-white custom brand, a smaller thin orange handwritten line and still smaller explanatory text; its successful mechanism is role contrast, not a single calligraphy treatment for all copy.
main_methods.not_proved: No exact M bounding-box measurement, validated universal ratio, formal poster or independent aesthetic pass.
